projects.title: Doc4Baby — Child Healthcare Platform
projects.subtitle: Sri Lanka • INTTEQ (Pvt) Ltd
projects.description: Healthcare mobile and web ecosystem by INTTEQ (Pvt) Ltd connecting parents with pediatric doctors, supporting child health management and PayHere subscription payments.
projects.more:
Built across React Native (Expo) for iOS/Android and Next.js for the web portal, integrating secure PayHere payment gateway subscriptions, doctor consultations, and timely health push notifications.

Doc4Baby is a baby and child health record app that keeps your child's clinic visits, vaccinations, medicine reminders and growth in one secure place, from newborn to school age.

CHILD HEALTH RECORDS
• Save clinic visits, doctor notes, prescriptions and lab reports
• Add photos and PDF documents to each record
• Share records with your child's pediatrician
• See your child's full medical history anytime, anywhere

VACCINATION & IMMUNIZATION TRACKER
• Keep track of your child's vaccination schedule and history
• Get reminders so you never miss a vaccine
• Save batch numbers, dates and vaccine card photos

MEDICINE & APPOINTMENT REMINDERS
• Baby medicine reminders for morning, afternoon, evening and night
• Repeat every 4, 6, 8, 12 or 24 hours
• Doctor appointment and checkup reminders
• Full-screen alerts that are hard to miss
• Swipe to mark a dose as done

BABY GROWTH TRACKER
• Record weight, height and head circumference
• See your child's growth over time with clear charts

DOCTOR & CARE TEAM SHARING
• Connect with your child's doctor using a QR code
• Invite family members and caregivers
• You choose who can view and manage your child's profile
• Doctors get a simple patient view to follow your child's health

HOME HEALTH LOG
• Log temperature, symptoms and home care
• Track fever, cold, rash and other symptoms between doctor visits

MULTIPLE CHILDREN
• Manage all your children from one parent account
• Switch between child profiles in one tap
• Separate, organised records for each child

PRIVATE & SECURE
• PIN lock and Face ID / fingerprint protection
• Your child's health data is shared only with people you invite

PLANS
• New users get a 1-month free trial
• Monthly plan: renews automatically every month until you cancel. Cancel anytime in the app under Profile > Your Plan. You keep access until the end of the paid month.
• Annual plan: one payment for 12 months. It does not renew automatically and you won't be charged again.

Doc4Baby helps you organise your child's health information. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Always speak to a qualified doctor about your child's health.

blogs.title: Shipping Cross-Platform Apps to App Store & Google Play with Expo
blogs.subtitle: Field notes from building production React Native applications at INTTEQ.

blocks.content: Why React Native + Expo Scales Fast

Building production mobile applications across iOS and Android demands predictable release pipelines, rock-solid native integrations, and fast iteration cycles. Across projects like Dealrax, Doc4Baby, PlayZone, and Mangaliyam, Expo EAS builds dramatically reduced store submission friction.
Good mobile architecture isn’t just about screens — it’s reliable push notifications, resilient offline sync, and clean payment flows.

Always verify deep-link handling, test PayHere and third-party payment callbacks on physical devices, and validate push notification payloads in background, killed, and foreground states before submitting to App Store Connect or Play Console.
